name: pw-context-digest
notes: playwright-native/1's finding.context_digest is the canonicalDigest of stdio entries and attachments ({name, content_type, body_digest} -- src/adapters/playwright/recorder.ts buildFinding), separate from evidence_digest (errors only). A rerun with the same attachment body (A vs B) MUST leave still_fail_unchanged entries without context_changed (spec §3.6: annex material carrying compositions compute context_digest; identical annex -> no context_changed). Changing only the attachment body via env (A vs C, PW_ATTACH_BODY) MUST NOT alter evidence_digest (the assertion is a fixed, env-independent failure) so the transition stays still_fail_unchanged (§7.3: context_digest does not affect transition classification) -- but MUST set context_changed: true with an anchor on that entry, disclosing the attachment-only diff.
